Name of Disease: Allergic Dermatitis  

- Risk Level: Moderate (depends on individual sensitivity and exposure to allergens)  
- Related Symptoms: Itching, redness, swelling, rashes  

A. Recommendation Medication 1: Diphenhydramine (Benadryl)  
  - Dosage: 25-50 mg orally every 4-6 hours as needed  
  - Usage Instructions: Do not exceed 300 mg per day; often used at bedtime due to sedative effects.  
  - Side Effects: Drowsiness, dry mouth, dizziness, constipation  

B. Recommendation Medication 2: Hydrocortisone (topical corticosteroid)  
  - Dosage: Apply a thin layer 1-2 times daily for up to 2 weeks  
  - Usage Instructions: Should be applied to affected areas as needed; do not use on facial or genital skin without guidance.  
  - Side Effects: Skin thinning, irritation, acne, increased hair growth  

C. Recommendation Medication 3: Loratadine (Claritin)  
  - Dosage: 10 mg once daily  
  - Usage Instructions: Can be taken with or without food.  
  - Side Effects: Headache, dry mouth, fatigue  

D. Recommendation Medication 4: Cetirizine (Zyrtec)  
  - Dosage: 10 mg once daily  
  - Usage Instructions: Preferably taken in the evening to minimize sedation.  
  - Side Effects: Drowsiness, dry mouth, dizziness, stomach pain  

E. Recommendation Medication 5: Clobetasol (super high potency corticosteroid)  
  - Dosage: Apply a small amount to the affected area once or twice daily for no more than 2 weeks  
  - Usage Instructions: Only for short-term use to avoid side effects; do not use on face or underarms without medical advice.  
  - Side Effects: Skin atrophy, burning, itching, folliculitis

Nama Penyakit: Faringitis Akut  
- Tingkat Risiko: Umumnya berisiko rendah, tetapi dapat meningkat pada individu dengan sistem kekebalan yang lemah atau komplikasi yang tidak ditangani.  
- Gejala Terkait: Sakit tenggorokan, kesulitan menelan, pembengkakan tonsil, demam, nyeri kepala, dan kelelahan.  

A. Rekomendasi Obat 1: Paracetamol  
  - Dosis: Dewasa 500 mg setiap 6-8 jam, maksimal 4g/hari.  
  - Aturan Pakai: Diminum dengan air setelah makan.  
  - Efek Samping Obat: Reaksi alergi, kerusakan hati.  

B. Rekomendasi Obat 2: Ibuprofen  
  - Dosis: Dewasa 200-400 mg setiap 4-6 jam, maksimal 1200 mg/hari.  
  - Aturan Pakai: Diminum dengan makanan atau susu.  
  - Efek Samping Obat: Sakit perut, mual, pusing.  

C. Rekomendasi Obat 3: Amoxicillin  
  - Dosis: Dewasa 250-500 mg setiap 8 jam.  
  - Aturan Pakai: Diminum dengan atau tanpa makanan.  
  - Efek Samping Obat: Ruam kulit, diare, alergi.  

D. Rekomendasi Obat 4: Throat Lozenges (permen pelega tenggorokan)  
  - Dosis: Sesuai petunjuk pada kemasan, biasanya 1 lozenge setiap 2-4 jam.  
  - Aturan Pakai: Hisap sampai larut di mulut.  
  - Efek Samping Obat: Mual atau gangguan pencernaan jika dikonsumsi berlebihan.  

E. Rekomendasi Obat 5: Antihistamin (seperti Diphenhydramine)  
  - Dosis: Dewasa 25-50 mg sebelum tidur.  
  - Aturan Pakai: Diminum dengan air.  
  - Efek Samping Obat: Kantuk, mulut kering.

- Related Symptoms: Redness, swelling, pus in the area

  - Usage Guidelines: Cover with a bandage after application  
  - Common Side Effects: Rash, itching

  - Dosage: Use as needed for coverage  
  - Usage Guidelines: Change daily or when wet/dirty  
  - Common Side Effects: None

  - Dosage: 200-400 mg every 4-6 hours as needed  
  - Usage Guidelines: Do not exceed 1200 mg/day without doctor supervision  
  - Common Side Effects: Stomach upset, headache

  - Dosage: Consult healthcare provider  
  - Usage Guidelines: Based on the injury and vaccination history
